description: Provision an AWS Rds DBSubnetGroup via the ACK rds controller. Fields mirror the rds.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1 DBSubnetGroup spec.

description.description: The description for the DB subnet group.

name.description:
The name for the DB subnet group. This value is stored as a lowercase string.

Constraints:

   * Must contain no more than 255 letters, numbers, periods, underscores,
   spaces, or hyphens.

   * Must not be default.

   * First character must be a letter.

Example: mydbsubnetgroup

region.description: AWS region for this resource (e.g. eu-west-1). Rendered as the services.k8s.aws/region annotation. Empty inherits the ACK controller's default region.
region.title: AWS region

subnetIDs.description: The EC2 Subnet IDs for the DB subnet group.
